headline: R and Python tools package established methods for reproducible omics analysis
label: Omics Analysis Software Tools
summary: Recent releases integrate LC-MS/MS metabolomics, microbiome, metabarcoding, and phylogenetic tree outputs into single reproducible analysis environments.
synthesis: The dominant thread is software that makes established algorithms interoperable and reproducible, primarily through integration and interface design. Rsearch exposes VSEARCH to R users with visualization, parameter tuning, and phyloseq compatibility for metabarcoding. SimpleMicrobiome packages taxa profiling, diversity, and differential abundance testing (ANCOM-BC2, MaAsLin2) in a Shiny interface. eCOMET harmonizes LC-MS/MS outputs from mzmine, modified cosine, DreaMS, and SIRIUS for ecological diversity and disparity analyses. baltic parses, manipulates, and plots phylogenetic trees from BEAST, Newick, and Auspice JSON inputs. What is new is the integration layer: cross-tool input compatibility and checksummed, JSON-specified figure construction in MakeMyFigure. The thread is not uniform, since figure construction and tree visualization serve presentation and downstream interpretation rather than primary analysis.
